note: v1, WHOLE (first round, composed from scratch): NUCLEATION, the seed. E1 (posted in motifs.md: D4/8 A4/8. C5/16 G4/4 E4/4. ./4, five notes in 5/4, D with no third) does not get stated, it FORMS. Each of its five notes is its own voice, wide in the field (kalimba D, vibes A, celesta C, glass G, the Game Boy wave E), repeating on its own cycle (9/7/8/6/5 beats) and a little out of tune (up to 0.4 semitone, pulled into tune as the crest nears). The notes drift past each other in scrambled orders until every cycle lands on one shared downbeat at bar 57: the five notes sound in order, in tune, for the first time (a breath, a whispered 'ah' through pvoc, a beat before). Then they lock to 5/4 over the 4/4 floor (they meet every five bars), doubled whole on a glock, with the inversion answering as a canon on ks-harp, the noise hat ticking the cell's own rhythm and a soft 808 in half time. Under it the quartal stack of E1 grows note by note on the GB wave pad (D A, + E, + C, + G), a warm Juno fifth and the NES triangle bass. The last 16 bars (the t1->t2 overlap, flat at 90) let E1 fall: augmented x2, sinking a semitone, filters closing. Tempo 84 -> 90; 265 s.
